correctness.rationale: A prescribed greedy packing word is characterized exactly by pairwise packing (P) and a lower-color witness (G) for each assigned color. Periodic lifting of a finite cyclic greedy word of maximum color k to the bi-infinite path preserves (P), since repeat spacing n>k, and (G), hence the known Gamma_rho(Z)=7 gives a universal cycle upper bound. Nine literal witnesses establish five extra finite orders and four seeds of lengths 28–31. Inserting (1,2,1,3) at prescribed cuts preserves P,G for t=0..3 by direct checking. For t>=4 the inserted 4t block is longer than radius-7 double neighborhoods, and seed segment length>=28; any radius-7 neighborhood is represented in the t=4 seed or the four pure-periodic phases, proving all lengths >=28.
